content: Large Data Path TP CopyRxData Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_00066 When Com_CopyRxData is invoked for an I-PDU with ComIPduLargeData set to true, AUTOSAR COM module shall use the passed I-PDU ID as Handle Id ( ComIP- duHandleId ) to derive the corresponding <ComUser_ComCbkCopyRxData> user notification callback and call it with the according Com user callback handle Id.
